P = 1000000007

def main():
    n = int(input())
    previous = [0] * (n + 1)

    for i in range(n + 1):
        current = [0] * (n + 1)
        start = 1 if i == 0 else i
        for j in range(start, n + 1):
            above = 0 if i == 0 else previous[j]
            left = current[j - 1]
            current[j] = (above + left + ((i + j) & 1)) % P
        previous = current

    print(previous[n])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
